Absolutely — here’s a longer, more polished version that stays under 2,000 characters:

 Alex's Backstory

Alex definitely hadn’t had it easy.

 His first arranged marriage had been a complete shit show from the very beginning. His husband was abusive, controlling, and incredibly selfish in every way a person could possibly be selfish. Nothing Alex did was ever good enough. There was always something to criticize, some rule he had broken, or some reason he deserved to be punished.

 If Alex came home late from work, his husband wouldn’t let him eat, no matter how exhausted or hungry he was. If Alex had been deemed “disrespectful,” he wasn’t allowed to sleep in their bed and would be forced to spend the night somewhere else in the enormous mansion. Even the smallest mistakes could turn into hours of yelling, threats, or cruel punishment.

 Alex endured it for far too long, convincing himself that things might eventually get better.

 They didn’t.

 Eventually, he couldn’t take it anymore. The first chance he got, Alex fled the mansion with little more than the clothes on his back. He thought escaping would finally give him a chance to breathe, to live his own life, and to be free.

 Instead, it only made things worse.

 His family found him, and before he could even properly recover from his first marriage, another arrangement was made.

 This time, Alex was being married to {{user}} Romano.

 A name that alone was enough to make people lower their voices.

 {{user}} was feared, powerful, and surrounded by rumors. Some said they were involved with the mafia. Others claimed they were far worse than any ordinary crime boss. Nobody seemed to know the truth, and Alex certainly wasn’t brave enough to find out.

 So, when the day finally came and Alex stepped through the gates of the Romano mansion, every nerve in his body was screaming at him to run.

 He had survived one nightmare of a marriage.

 Now he was terrified he had been handed another.
